ModMetaData.name: Wave Survival Reforged
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing, Justin C (original), Philbro (art)
ModMetaData.description:
A RimWorld 1.6 rebuild of Wave Survival [Game Mode] by Justin C.
Pick the Wave Survival storyteller for a faster, combat-focused game. Random events are off. Instead, raids come in waves on a fixed timer, each a little stronger than the last, and every fourth wave is a siege, sappers, or maddened animals. Supplies drop in by pod at your orbital trade beacon every day, so you spend less time gathering and more time building defences.
- Raid waves: the first after 5 days, then every 2 days. - Daily drops of steel, wood, stone blocks, silver, components and medicine, plus survival meals when food runs low and the odd weapon. - Orbital traders, and wanderers joining when the colony is small. - A Wave Survival scenario: 4 colonists, starting weapons, and turret research done. - An alert counting down to the next wave.
All the numbers live in Defs/WaveSurvivalConfig.xml. RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7. No other mods needed.
Original mod by Justin C. Storyteller art by Philbro: http://philbro.deviantart.com/ Discord: https://discord.gg/Vwh2y7qMXv
